title: Add setting to disable cursor wrap in Game Mode (full screen D3D application).

proposed_comments.title: Make the live Game Mode toggle atomic
proposed_comments.body:
### Make the live Game Mode toggle atomic

**Severity:** `high`

`set_config` can update this option while `MouseHookProc` reads it on the separately created hook thread. Keeping the shared value as a plain `bool` makes live settings changes a C++ data race; use the atomic type already used by the adjacent hook state.

```suggestion
    std::atomic_bool m_disableInGameMode{ false }; // Default to false: only disable wrapping in game mode when the user opts in
```

confidence.rationale: Exact source tracing shows an unsynchronized settings-thread write and hook-thread read. The one-line atomic replacement built independently on the pinned upstream tree.
